content:
<PLOT_SUMMARY>
Govardhan (Vijay Devarakonda) is a family man who works in a business to provide for his family. However, he meets Indu (Mrunal Thakur) when she moves into his 'space'. Soon, they both fall in love.

After learning that his flight tickets weren't paid for, he resorts to Indu, who provides money for his family. It is revealed that Indu is actually the daughter of the head. Heartbroken, Indu isolates herself from him after falling in love again and hearing him talking to a lady negatively about Indu, saying that she isn't the right person for him.

Govardhan finds out Indu's true intentions of writing the thesis from her father and proceeds to stop her from a wedding, held for one person who got injured due to Govardhan and (according to the person's grandfather- a famous politician) would be the only thing to make him feel better. He uses that advance to defy whatever Indu has written in her thesis. However, when he finds her thesis on his family and him, he slaps her and vows to teach her a lesson.

Govardhan defeats the politician's goons along with his mother, wins back Indu, and marries her at the end. That to, Indu and his family quickly become friends. Though annoyed, he continues on in the company, but demands everything Indu gets. After a big incident, he reconciles with his brother after his mother reveals to Indu that his brother hated him because of Govardhan shaming him.

When she is questioned about her unusual behavior, she tells a story about her past. However, it is revealed that Indu is at that wedding. After revealing that she heard him that day, she leaves him. Present: A woman named Indu (Mrunal Thakur) sadly sits in the middle of a ceremony.
</PLOT_SUMMARY>
